title: DASH activation error towards the end of the process
body:
@Avereha
This is the 2nd or 3rd DASH activation that gives this same error.
![Screenshot_20211225-203056_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/147392342-caa1c232-573d-40c1-b59f-7598bbd56c2a.jpg)
The pod is on body, the canula is inserted. Seems like the "all ok" message from pod is not received by AAPS. Hitting "Retry" button solves the error and the initiation finalize correctly.

Look at logs around 20:30

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1640460676500.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7776210/AndroidAPS_LOG_1640460676500.log.zip)
